narrative.intro: JT4 shows $376M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date, recorded from 1 award with an average award size of $376M. Obligations fell 5.6% year over year. Historical totals show steady activity across prior fiscal years: FY21 $322M, FY22 $325M, FY23 $391M, FY24 $385M, and FY25 $398M. The current-year total is a partial fiscal-year-to-date figure. All figures here refer to contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Agency-level buyers, product descriptions, and expiring-contract details are not included in the available figures, so the overview focuses on obligations, award count, and year-over-year change. Readers should treat the FY2026 total as incomplete for the full fiscal year because the reporting note specifies current-year totals are partial.

sections.heading: How have JT4's obligations trended over recent fiscal years?
